army_rules.name: Dark Pacts
army_rules.rules_text:
If your Army Faction is HERETIC ASTARTES, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of that Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit's weapons to gain until the end of the phase: [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

FAQ: Can I select a unit to shoot when there are no eligible targets so that unit can make a Dark Pact- No.

FAQ: When I select a unit as the target of the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, can that unit make a Dark Pact- Yes, as the unit is selected to shoot.

options.name: Dark Pacts - Lethal Hits
options.rules_text: After taking the required Leadership test, weapons equipped by models in this unit have [LETHAL HITS] until the end of the phase.

options.name: Dark Pacts - Sustained Hits
options.rules_text: After taking the required Leadership test, weapons equipped by models in this unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] until the end of the phase.

army_rules.name: Cult of the Dark Gods
army_rules.rules_text:
If your Army Faction is HERETIC ASTARTES, you can include any of the following units in your army, and when you do so their Faction keywords are replaced with HERETIC ASTARTES: KHORNE BERZERKERS, RUBRIC MARINES, PLAGUE MARINES and NOISE MARINES.

The combined points value of such units you can include in your army depends on the battle size: Incursion up to 250 pts; Strike Force up to 500 pts; Onslaught up to 750 pts.

FAQ: If I use the Cults of the Dark Gods rule to add Plague Marines to my Chaos Space Marines army, does the Plague Marines' Infused with the Blessings of Nurgle ability have any effect- No.

options.name: Incursion
options.rules_text: Up to 250 points of listed cult units can be included.

options.name: Strike Force
options.rules_text: Up to 500 points of listed cult units can be included.

options.name: Onslaught
options.rules_text: Up to 750 points of listed cult units can be included.

rule.name: FOCUS OF HATRED
rule.rules_text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army to be your focus of hatred. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army (excluding DAMNED models) makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: EAGER FOR VENGEANCE
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). The bearer's unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, if the bearer's unit Fell Back this turn, add 1 to the Hit roll, and each time you select your focus of hatred as a target of that unit's charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.

enhancements.name: EYE OF ABADDON
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your focus of hatred is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: MARK OF LEGEND
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one saving throw made for the bearer.

options.name: Mark of Legend - Hit roll
options.rules_text: Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll made for the bearer.

options.name: Mark of Legend - Wound roll
options.rules_text: Once per turn, you can re-roll one Wound roll made for the bearer.

enhancements.name: WARMASTER'S GIFT
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, an unmodified successful Wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.

stratagems.name: ENDLESS IRE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.

stratagems.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: BRINGERS OF DESPAIR
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.

stratagems.name: BLACK CRUSADE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, bolt guns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.name: LET THE GALAXY BURN
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.name: MILLENNIA OF EXPERIENCE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

rule.name: MASTERS OF MISDIRECTION
rule.rules_text: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select a number of LEGIONARIES and CULTIST MOB units from your army until the end of the battle; those units, and any CHARACTER units attached to them (excluding EPIC HEROES), have the Infiltrators ability. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size: Incursion: up to 2 LEGIONARIES units and up to 2 CULTIST MOB units; Strike Force: up to 3 LEGIONARIES units and up to 3 CULTIST MOB units; Onslaught: up to 4 LEGIONARIES units and up to 4 CULTIST MOB units.

enhancements.name: CURSED FANG
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons by 1, and the bearer's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: FALSEHOOD
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD model only (excluding TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models). In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can set the bearer up in Reserves instead of setting it up on the battlefield. If you do, in one of your Movement phases, you can select one model in a friendly LEGIONARIES or CHOSEN unit that has two or more models remaining and is on the battlefield (excluding Attached units). The selected model is destroyed (ignoring any rules that are triggered when a model is destroyed) and the bearer is set up as close as possible to where that model was destroyed and only within Engagement Range of any enemy units if the destroyed model was within Engagement Range of those units. The bearer now attaches to that unit as its Leader.

enhancements.name: SHROUD OF OBFUSCATION
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.

enhancements.name: SOUL LINK
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. At the start of your Command phase, you can select one other HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER model from your army (excluding EPIC HEROES). Until the start of your next Command phase, the bearer gains the PSYKER keyword, and replace the bearer's datasheet abilities with the datasheet abilities of the CHARACTER you selected.

stratagems.name: DETONATOR
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 18" of that enemy model when it was destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your opponent does not roll to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by their model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted (if that ability inflicts a random number of mortal wounds, your opponent rolls to determine that number as normal).
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an enemy model with the Deadly Demise ability (excluding TITANIC models) is destroyed.

stratagems.name: FROM ALL SIDES
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit for each other HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this phase (to a maximum of +3).
stratagems.timing: The start of your Charge phase.

stratagems.name: PICK THEM OFF
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.name: COILS OF DECEPTION
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS PURSUIT
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

stratagems.name: SCRAMBLED COORDINATES
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your unit.
stratagems.timing: Start of the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase.

rule.name: RAIDERS AND REAVERS
rule.rules_text: Ranged weapons equipped by HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability, and each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: DESPOT'S CLAIM
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is wholly within 12" of your opponent's deployment zone: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: DREAD REAVER
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if the bearer is wholly within 12" of your opponent's deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: MARK OF THE HOUND
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: TYRANT'S LASH
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. You can re-roll Advance rolls made for the bearer's unit, and the bearer's unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

stratagems.name: UNFAILINGLY OBDURATE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: SCOUR AND SEIZE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.

stratagems.name: OPPORTUNISTIC RAIDERS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", or up to 12" if it is a MOUNTED unit. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.timing: End of the Fight phase.

stratagems.name: WARPCHARGED ENGINES
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.name: RUINOUS RAID
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase.

stratagems.name: REAVERS' HASTE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If you select one or more units within range of an objective marker as a target of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.

rule.name: TERROR DESCENDS (AURA)
rule.rules_text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each time an enemy unit within 12" of one or more HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army takes a Battle-shock test, subtract 1 from the result. Enemy units affected by this Detachment rule do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

enhancements.name: EATER OF DREAD
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result for each Battle-shocked enemy unit that is on the battlefield: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: NIGHT'S SHROUD
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD model only (excluding TERMINATOR models). Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth ability.
restrictions: CHAOS LORD model only (excluding TERMINATOR models).

enhancements.name: WARP-FUELLED THRUSTERS
enhancements.rules_text: JUMP PACK CHAOS LORD model only. At the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
restrictions: JUMP PACK CHAOS LORD model only.

enhancements.name: WILLBREAKER
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. In the Fight phase, after the bearer has made its attacks, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

stratagems.name: DEPTHLESS CRUELTY
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.

stratagems.name: BLOODY EXAMPLE
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys a CHARACTER unit.

stratagems.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS TERROR
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army Falls Back.

stratagems.name: SCREAMING DESCENT
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge. Then select one enemy INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit within 9" of and visible to your unit: that unit must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.timing: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS PURSUIT
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that Fell Back this turn and is within 6" of your unit. Your unit can declare a charge as if it were your Charge phase. When doing so, you can only select that enemy unit as the target of that charge (and only if it is an eligible target). Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Movement phase.

rule.name: IRON FORTITUDE
rule.rules_text: Each time a ranged attack targets a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: BASTION PLATE
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD model only (excluding JUMP PACK models). Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for the bearer's unit, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.
restrictions: CHAOS LORD model only (excluding JUMP PACK models).

enhancements.name: IRON ARTIFICE
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. The bearer's weapons have the [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] and [ANTI-FORTIFICATION 4+] abilities.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model only.

enhancements.name: IRONBOUND ENMITY
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack while within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: WARP TRACER
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

stratagems.name: PERSISTENT ASSAILANTS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more attacks this phase and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.

stratagems.name: BRUTAL ATTRITION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack is allocated to a model in your unit, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6 (to a maximum of six D6 per attacking unit): for each 4+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: PITILESS CANNONADE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK DESTRUCTION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit's ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons) have the [PISTOL] ability.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.name: STEADFAST DETERMINATION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: SIEGECRAFT
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.

detachments.name: PACTBOUND ZEALOTS

rule.name: MARKS OF CHAOS
rule.rules_text:
When mustering your army, when you select a HERETIC ASTARTES unit to include in your army, if that unit is not an EPIC HERO and does not already have one of the following keywords, you must select one for that unit and note it on your Army Roster: KHORNE, TZEENTCH, NURGLE, SLAANESH, CHAOS UNDIVIDED. Each time a unit with one of these keywords gains a weapon ability as the result of a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, until the end of the phase, that unit gains the associated ability below.

UNITS THAT GAINED [LETHAL HITS]
- KHORNE: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
- TZEENTCH: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
- CHAOS UNDIVIDED: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

UNITS THAT GAINED [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
- NURGLE: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
- SLAANESH: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
- CHAOS UNDIVIDED: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

options.name: Marks of Chaos - Khorne
options.rules_text: After this unit makes a successful Dark Pact for Lethal Hits, its melee attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

options.name: Marks of Chaos - Tzeentch
options.rules_text: After this unit makes a successful Dark Pact for Lethal Hits, its ranged attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

options.name: Marks of Chaos - Nurgle
options.rules_text: After this unit makes a successful Dark Pact for Sustained Hits 1, its ranged attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

options.name: Marks of Chaos - Slaanesh
options.rules_text: After this unit makes a successful Dark Pact for Sustained Hits 1, its melee attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

options.name: Marks of Chaos - Chaos Undivided
options.rules_text: After this unit makes a successful Dark Pact for either pact ability, re-roll Hit rolls of 1 until the end of the phase.

restrictions: You cannot select the KHORNE keyword for a PSYKER unit.
A CHARACTER unit can only be attached to a unit if both units share the same keyword from the list above.
A unit can only embark within (or start the battle embarked within) a TRANSPORT if both of those units share the same keyword from the list above.

enhancements.name: EYE OF TZEENTCH
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES TZEENTCH model only. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, if the result of that test was 8 or more, you gain 1CP.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES TZEENTCH model only.

enhancements.name: INTOXICATING ELIXIR
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES SLAANESH model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Each time the bearer shoots or fights, if the bearer's unit made a Dark Pact this phase and did not fail the resulting Leadership test, after the bearer has resolved those attacks, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES SLAANESH model only.

enhancements.name: ORBS OF UNLIFE
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES NURGLE model only. At the end of the Fight phase, roll one D6 for every enemy unit within 3" of the bearer, adding 1 to the result if the bearer's unit made a Dark Pact that phase and did not fail the resulting Leadership test: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES NURGLE model only.

options.name: Orbs of Unlife
options.rules_text: At the end of the Fight phase, roll one D6 for the selected enemy unit within 3" of the bearer: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

options.name: Orbs of Unlife - Dark Pact Passed
options.rules_text: At the end of the Fight phase, roll one D6 for the selected enemy unit within 3" of the bearer, adding 1 because the bearer's unit made and passed a Dark Pact: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: TALISMAN OF BURNING BLOOD
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES KHORNE model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, roll one D3: until the end of the phase, add the result to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons instead.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES KHORNE model only.

options.name: Talisman of Burning Blood - Base
options.rules_text: Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.

options.name: Talisman of Burning Blood - Dark Pact +1
options.rules_text: After a successful Dark Pact, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.

options.name: Talisman of Burning Blood - Dark Pact +2
options.rules_text: After a successful Dark Pact, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.

options.name: Talisman of Burning Blood - Dark Pact +3
options.rules_text: After a successful Dark Pact, add 3 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.

stratagems.name: EYE OF THE GODS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER model in that unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, add 1 to the Move, Toughness and Wounds characteristics of that CHARACTER model, and add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of that CHARACTER model's melee weapons.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED, DAEMON and EPIC HERO units) destroys an enemy unit.

stratagems.name: ETERNAL HATE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is a KHORNE unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: PROFANE ZEAL
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHAOS UNDIVIDED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.name: SKINSHIFT
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds. In addition, if your unit is a TZEENTCH unit and is Below its Starting Strength, one destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit with its full wounds remaining.
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.

stratagems.name: TORPEFYING REFRAIN
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is a SLAANESH unit, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.name: FESTERING MIASMA
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability. In addition, if your unit is a NURGLE unit, it can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

rule.name: DESPERATE DEVOTION
rule.rules_text:
Each time a DAMNED unit from your army with the Dark Pacts ability is selected to make a Normal or Advance move or declare a charge (excluding units that arrived from Reserves this turn), it can make a Desperate Pact (see below). If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 2 to Charge rolls made for that unit.

Desperate Pacts: Each time a unit makes a Desperate Pact, it must first take a Leadership test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds before any effects of that Desperate Pact are resolved.

additional_rules.name: KEYWORDS
additional_rules.rules_text: TRAITOR GUARDSMEN SQUAD units from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

enhancements.name: AMULET OF TAINTED VIGOUR
enhancements.rules_text: DARK APOSTLE model only. In your Command phase, you can return up to D3 destroyed DAMNED models (excluding CHARACTER models) to the bearer's unit.
restrictions: DARK APOSTLE model only.

enhancements.name: CULTIST'S BRAND
enhancements.rules_text: DARK APOSTLE or DAMNED model only. If every other model in the bearer's unit (excluding Dark Disciples) is DAMNED, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.
restrictions: DARK APOSTLE or DAMNED model only.

enhancements.name: INCENDIARY GOAD
enhancements.rules_text: DARK APOSTLE or DAMNED model only. While the bearer's unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by DAMNED models in that unit, and while that unit is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons as well.
restrictions: DARK APOSTLE or DAMNED model only.

enhancements.name: WARPED FORESIGHT
enhancements.rules_text: DARK APOSTLE model only. While the bearer is leading a unit with the Scouts 6" ability, every model in the bearer's unit has the Scouts 6" ability.
restrictions: DARK APOSTLE model only.

stratagems.name: CHOSEN FOR GLORY
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

options.name: Chosen for Glory - Failed Desperate Pact
options.rules_text: After making a Desperate Pact, attacks re-roll Hit rolls until the end of the phase.

options.name: Chosen for Glory - Passed Desperate Pact
options.rules_text: After making a Desperate Pact and not failing the Leadership test, attacks re-roll Hit rolls and Wound rolls until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: SELFLESS DEMISE
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: INFERNAL SACRIFICE
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (in addition to any suffered for failing the resulting Leadership test), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, until the end of the phase, improve the Strength characteristic of those weapons by 1 as well.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.

options.name: Infernal Sacrifice - Failed Desperate Pact
options.rules_text: After making a Desperate Pact, melee weapons have +1 Attacks until the end of the phase.

options.name: Infernal Sacrifice - Passed Desperate Pact
options.rules_text: After making a Desperate Pact and not failing the Leadership test, melee weapons have +1 Attacks and +1 Strength until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: CRAZED FOCUS
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.

options.name: Crazed Focus - Failed Desperate Pact
options.rules_text: After making a Desperate Pact, ranged attacks improve Armour Penetration by 1 until the end of the phase.

options.name: Crazed Focus - Passed Desperate Pact
options.rules_text: After making a Desperate Pact and not failing the Leadership test, ranged attacks improve Armour Penetration and Strength by 1 until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: RECKLESS HASTE
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.

stratagems.name: MORTAL THRALLS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly DAMNED unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while your DAMNED unit is on the battlefield, each time your opponent would make a Wound roll for an attack that targets your HERETIC ASTARTES unit, if your DAMNED unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no roll is made; instead, your DAMNED unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

rule.name: DEBT TO THE SOUL FORGE
rule.rules_text: Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army makes a Dark Pact, it can invoke its contract. If it does, subtract 1 from the resulting Leadership test when making that Dark Pact, and until the end of the phase: each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll; add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

options.name: Debt to the Soul Forge - Invoke Contract
options.rules_text: After invoking its contract, ranged attacks add 1 to Wound rolls and melee weapons have +2 Attacks until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: FORGE'S BLESSING
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: INVIGORATED MECHADENDRILS
enhancements.rules_text: WARPSMITH model only. Add 4" to the bearer's Move characteristic.
restrictions: WARPSMITH model only.

enhancements.name: TEMPTING ADDENDUM
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army invokes its contract while within 9" of the bearer: if it suffers one or more mortal wounds as a result of that Dark Pact, add 1 to the number of mortal wounds it suffers; until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: SOUL HARVESTER
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

stratagems.name: DESPERATE PLEDGE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.name: GLUT OF SOULS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved, to a maximum of 6 wounds.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.

stratagems.name: DAEMONIC POSSESSION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding DAEMON units).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the DAEMON keyword.
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE RAMPAGE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or Charge phase.

stratagems.name: PREDATORY PURSUIT
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

stratagems.name: FEEDING FRENZY
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units that is within Engagement Range of your unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) is selected to Fall Back.

rule.name: EXPERIMENTAL AUGMENTATIONS
rule.rules_text:
At the start of the battle, select which augmentations are active for HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models (excluding DAMNED models) from your army until the end of the battle. To do so, either select one from the list below, or randomly determine two by rolling two D6. If Fabius Bile is your WARLORD, when randomly determining your augmentations, you can re-roll one or both of the dice. Duplicated augmentations have no additional effect.

1 - Cholinergic Accelerants: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
2 - Hyperadrenal Infusion: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of this model.
3 - Paranormal Reactions: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model by 1.
4 - Supracutaneous Chitinisation: Improve the Toughness characteristic of this model by 1.
5 - Macrotensile Sinews: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
6 - Ophthalmic Enhancement: Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by this model by 1.

options.name: Experimental Augmentations - Cholinergic Accelerants
options.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models have +1 Attack on melee weapons.

options.name: Experimental Augmentations - Paranormal Reactions
options.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models improve melee Weapon Skill by 1.

options.name: Experimental Augmentations - Supracutaneous Chitinisation
options.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models have +1 Toughness.

options.name: Experimental Augmentations - Macrotensile Sinews
options.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models have +1 Strength on melee weapons.

options.name: Experimental Augmentations - Ophthalmic Enhancement
options.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models improve ranged Ballistic Skill by 1.

enhancements.name: SURGICAL PRECISION
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). The bearer's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models).

enhancements.name: LIVING CARAPACE
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD model only. Add 1 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic and the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
restrictions: CHAOS LORD model only.

enhancements.name: HELM OF ALL-SEEING
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model (excluding DAMNED models) only. Enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model only (excluding DAMNED models).

enhancements.name: PRIME TEST SUBJECT
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model only (excluding DAMNED models). Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model only (excluding DAMNED models).

stratagems.name: MONSTROUS VISAGES
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: MASTERS ARE WATCHING
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, subtracting 1 from the result if it is a DAMNED unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: SPECIMENS FOR THE SPIDER
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll. After your unit has fought, if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the enemy WARLORD was destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test instead.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.

stratagems.name: DELAYED MUTATIONS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
stratagems.effect: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one augmentation from the Experimental Augmentations Detachment rule that is not currently active for your army. Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the selected augmentation in addition to any other augmentations they have.
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.

stratagems.name: DIABOLIC REGENERATION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
stratagems.effect: One destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit if your unit is a BATTLELINE unit, or D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) are returned to your unit instead.
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.

stratagems.name: AUTOSTIMULANTS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.timing: Start of your Charge phase.

rule.name: TERROR MADE MANIFEST
rule.rules_text:
In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. Enemy units affected by this Detachment rule do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Each time an attack targets a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army, if the attacking model is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets a Battle-shocked unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: GREYVEIL HEX
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth ability. While the bearer's unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control, that unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
restrictions: CHAOS LORD model only.

enhancements.name: WARP-FUELLED THRUSTERS
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD JUMP PACK model only. At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
restrictions: CHAOS LORD JUMP PACK model only.

enhancements.name: TERRORGOUT PARASITE
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: SCORROWCENT VULTURE
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD JUMP PACK model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability. In the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a WARP TALONS unit.
restrictions: CHAOS LORD JUMP PACK model only.

stratagems.name: TALONS SUNK DEEP
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.name: PREY ON THE WEAK
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.name: SADISTIC DISPLAY
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of and visible to your unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

stratagems.name: MALICIOUS SURGE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS TERROR
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army Falls Back.

stratagems.name: HORRIFIC INCURSION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived from Reserves this turn.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) within 12" of and visible to your unit; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.

rule.name: TYRANNICAL MOTIVATION
rule.rules_text:
In your Command phase, select one of the following abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, each HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army has that ability. At the start of each phase, if such a unit is visible to a friendly HURON BLACKHEART model until the end of the phase, it has both of the following abilities instead.

Huron's Elite: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Mobile Marauders: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

options.name: Tyrannical Motivation - Huron's Elite
options.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models add 1 to Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: VOICE OF THE TYRANT
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). The bearer's unit has both abilities from the Tyrannical Motivation Detachment rule.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models).

enhancements.name: RAID LEADER
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Each time the bearer's unit is set up after disembarking from a TRANSPORT that has made a Normal move this turn, the bearer's unit is still eligible to declare a charge.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models).

enhancements.name: DREAD REPUTATION
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Each time the bearer's unit is set up on the battlefield, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer's unit (or within 12" if the bearer's unit was set up using the Deep Strike ability) takes a Battle-shock test.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models).

enhancements.name: EAGER FOR BLOODSHED
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Infiltrators ability.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

stratagems.name: HARDENED KILLERS
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one of the following effects: improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1; improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1; improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1. Until the start of your next turn, your unit has the benefit of that effect.
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.

options.name: Hardened Killers - Ballistic Skill
options.rules_text: Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons by 1 until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Hardened Killers - Rapid Fire Attacks
options.rules_text: Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons by 1 until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Hardened Killers - Save
options.rules_text: Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 until the start of your next turn.

stratagems.name: AT THE TYRANT'S COMMAND
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.name: SEIZE THE PRIZE
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Do not make an Advance roll for your unit. Instead, until the end of the phase add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army has been selected to Advance.

stratagems.name: REAVERS' FLURRY
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
stratagems.timing: Your Fight phase.

stratagems.name: TO THE FAVOURED THE SPOILS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

stratagems.name: ENCIRCLING SURGE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

rule.name: SLAVES TO NONE
rule.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army lose the Dark Pacts ability. Ranged weapons equipped by HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability. When mustering your army, you cannot use the Cults of the Dark Gods rule.

additional_rules.name: VENDETTA
additional_rules.rules_text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Vendetta target. Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army (excluding DAMNED models) makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

additional_rules.name: TWISTED DOCTRINE
additional_rules.rules_text: In your Movement phase, each time you set up or select a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding Battle-shocked units) from your army to move, it can choose to Default to Doctrine. If it does, it must first take a Battle-shock test. Then, select one of the following: until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back; or until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: WEAPONISED HATRED
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Once per battle round, after your Vendetta target is destroyed, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can select one enemy unit visible to the bearer. That enemy unit becomes your Vendetta target until you select a new one.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: EYES OF THE HUNTER
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

enhancements.name: FRATRICIDAL TROPHIES
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. In a turn in which the bearer's unit chose to Default to Doctrine, until the end of the turn, each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only.

enhancements.name: EMPYRIC SYMBIOTE
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only.

stratagems.name: NEVER OUTGUNNED
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

options.name: Never Outgunned - Lethal Hits
options.rules_text: Weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS] until the end of the phase.

options.name: Never Outgunned - Sustained Hits
options.rules_text: Weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: VENGEFUL DESTRUCTION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (excluding DAMNED units) or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.name: UNDYING HATRED
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: RENEGADE CLAIM
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.name: CORRUPTED MUNITIONS
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.name: REAVERS' REACTION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

rule.name: WARP PORTALS
rule.rules_text: At the end of your opponent's turn, you can select a number of HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS and MUTALITHS units from your army (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size: Incursion: up to 1 unit; Strike Force: up to 2 units; Onslaught: up to 3 units. Once you have made your selections, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: INFERNAL FULGURITE
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Once per battle, you can target the bearer's unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models).

enhancements.name: EYE OF THE WARP
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up on the battlefield, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only.

enhancements.name: AKSHUR'S BINDING RUNES
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer's unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only.

enhancements.name: TZAGULLA
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only. Improve the Attacks, Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer's weapons by 1. In addition, each time the bearer's unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves, until the end of the phase, improve the Damage characteristic of the bearer's weapons by 1.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only.

options.name: Tzagulla - From Reserves
options.rules_text: The bearer's weapons also have +1 Damage after the unit was set up from Reserves this phase.

stratagems.name: EMPYRIC DISLOCATION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CORRUPTION
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTALITHS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.name: WARP FLICKER
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTALITHS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.name: WARP-TAINTED
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTALITHS unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.name: SIEGEBREAKER STRIKE
stratagems.target: Up to two HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.name: PORTAL OF SPITE
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to Charge rolls.
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.

rule.name: SOULFORGE BOONS
rule.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE units from your army gain the DAEMON keyword. HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE, LORD DISCORDANT and VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE units from your army gain the SOUL FORGE keyword. SOUL FORGE units from your army have a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: WYREDJINN
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models).

enhancements.name: CYBINFERNAL FONT
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Models in the bearer's unit have the SOUL FORGE keyword.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models).

enhancements.name: MARK OF THE SOUL FORGES
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Each time the bearer makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models).

enhancements.name: CROWN OF WORMS
enhancements.rules_text: WARPSMITH model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer's Warpsmith, Master of Mechanisms and Enrage Machine Spirits abilities.
restrictions: WARPSMITH model only.

stratagems.name: TOUCH OF THE ARKIFANE
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit's weapons to gain.

stratagems.name: BALEFIRE BOON
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: SOUL-TALLY OFFERING
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: BIOMECHANOID REGENERATION
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.

stratagems.name: FORGE-FIRE SURGE
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.

stratagems.name: UNHOLY FORTITUDE
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

rule.name: EMPYRIC WELLSPRING
rule.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit (excluding DAMNED units) is selected to shoot, if that unit makes a Dark Pact, that unit's ranged attacks have +1 S. In the Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE/DAEMON PRINCE WITH WINGS unit (excluding KHORNE units) is selected to fight, if that unit makes a Dark Pact, that unit's melee attacks have +2 S and +1 AP.

options.name: Empyric Wellspring - Psyker Dark Pact
options.rules_text: After this HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit makes a Dark Pact, ranged attacks have +1 Strength.

options.name: Empyric Wellspring - Daemon Prince Dark Pact
options.rules_text: After this HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE unit makes a Dark Pact, melee attacks have +2 Strength and +1 AP.

enhancements.name: TOUCHED BY THE WARP
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding KHORNE models). This model has PSYKER. This model's weapons have [PSYCHIC].
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding KHORNE models).

enhancements.name: CONDUIT OF CHAOS
enhancements.rules_text: HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON model only (excluding KHORNE models). This model's melee attacks have [LANCE].
restrictions: HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON model only (excluding KHORNE models).

stratagems.name: INFERNAL VIGOUR
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).
stratagems.effect: Your unit heals D3+1 wounds.

stratagems.name: FLESHY CURSE
stratagems.timing: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6: on a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5-6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are inflicted by a Psychic Attack.

stratagems.name: WREATHED IN WARPFLAME
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

rule.name: RAIN OF RUIN
rule.rules_text: Friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS units' ranged attacks have [HEAVY].

enhancements.name: PACT OF DESTRUCTION
enhancements.rules_text: WARPSMITH model only. When this unit uses its Dark Pacts ability, this unit can re-roll Leadership rolls. In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if this unit used its Dark Pacts ability and if those attacks destroyed an enemy model, this unit heals 3 wounds.
restrictions: WARPSMITH model only.

enhancements.name: EYE OF OBLIVION
enhancements.rules_text: WARPSMITH model only. When this unit is selected to shoot, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range until this unit has shot.
restrictions: WARPSMITH model only.

stratagems.name: RUINATION'S BOUNTY
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.
stratagems.effect: When your unit uses the Dark Pacts ability, your unit's ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: SNARE OF FIRE
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HAVOCS unit.
stratagems.target: That HAVOCS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: UNDYING HATRED
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit targets a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.
stratagems.target: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a Strength greater than your unit's Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls.

options.name: Undying Hatred - Devotees of Destruction
options.rules_text: Attacks that target your unit with a Strength greater than your unit's Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls.

detachments.name: MURDERTALON RAIDERS

rule.name: PREY ON THE WEAK
rule.rules_text: Friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY units' attacks that target a Battle-shocked unit or a unit at or below Half-strength can re-roll Hit rolls of 1. When an enemy unit's attacks target a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked or at or below Half-strength, those attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.

restrictions: This detachment has the NIGHTMARE tag and cannot be taken with another NIGHTMARE detachment.

enhancements.name: SHADOWCOWL TALISMAN
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD WITH JUMP PACK model only. This unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.
restrictions: CHAOS LORD WITH JUMP PACK model only.

enhancements.name: PACT OF CURSED PINIONS
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS LORD WITH JUMP PACK model only. This model has DAEMON. This model's melee attacks have +1 A.
restrictions: CHAOS LORD WITH JUMP PACK model only.

stratagems.name: PLUNGING TALONS
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: RAKING PASS
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: WARP-TWISTED TERRORS
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WARP TALONS unit ends a move.
stratagems.target: That WARP TALONS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.

abilities.name: Dark Destiny
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model's unit makes a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership roll, if the result of that roll was 7+, you gain 1CP.

abilities.rules_text: While a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit (excluding DAMNED units) is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Guns Blazing
abilities.rules_text: Once per turn, in your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit makes a ranged attack that targets a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 3" of this model, after that enemy unit has shot, this model can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

abilities.name: Enhanced Warriors

abilities.name: Surgeon Acolyte
abilities.rules_text: Once per turn, when an attack is allocated to a model in this unit, if this unit contains FABIUS BILE, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

abilities.name: Chirurgeon
abilities.rules_text: The first time this unit's FABIUS BILE model is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set it back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, and not within Engagement Range of any enemy models, with its full wounds remaining.

abilities.name: Herald of the Apocalypse (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, in the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if that unit is below its Starting Strength, it must take a Battle-shock test. This ability cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

special_rules: Leader: This model can be attached to Raptors.

abilities.name: Hamadrya's Knowledge (Psychic)
abilities.rules_text: Once per battle round, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of this model's unit, if this model's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

abilities.rules_text: While this unit's Garreon the Corpsemaster is on the battlefield, in your Command phase, select one of the following: you can return 1 destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) to this unit, or, if one or more HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY units from your army are below Starting Strength and within 3" of this unit, you gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Fleet Command
abilities.rules_text: After both players have deployed their armies, if this unit is on the battlefield (or any TRANSPORT it is embarked within is on the battlefield) select up to three HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.
